scope: Design inspection only. No production source, test source, real Vault, operator receipt, Git, network, or human-gate mutation was performed.

prior_design_draft.status: review draft only; not an implementation freeze

findings.finding: The lightweight record is a validated, versioned product-workspace artifact, while source publication is a receipt-backed Vault transaction. Conversion is an adapter; a light record, index digest, or model proposal cannot be publication authority.
evidence: light_knowledge._record_bundle_ok validates the five-file record bundle, paper snapshot, source identity, wrapper, coverage, ancestry and completed-batch provenance.
light_index._index_is_current recomputes live page intervals, chunks, text hashes, stored chunks and document frequency.
source_publication.prepare_source_publication and inspect_source_publication require an audited publication basis and create an inspect authority; neither applies a transaction.

findings.finding: Conversion requires an exact capture and source-registration predecessor. A raw .md sibling without an external capture result and receipt-backed ledger claim is insufficient.
required_material: validated Markdown capture authority and approval-bound plan
validated capture operation-result authority when capture disposition is create
audited operation head bytes and complete receipt path-to-bytes map
earliest source-registration receipt and exact historical source-ledger snapshot bytes
current audited source ledger and registered raw Markdown bytes
all existing association, observation and extraction bytes
findings.refusal: Missing, incomplete, orphaned, noncanonical, or nonmatching receipt history is a typed refusal; conversion never mints source IDs, registration receipts, associations, or published status.

findings.finding: Build the formal Markdown observation from exact retained source.md bytes and source.json metadata/pages, then run markdown_source.validate_payload before identity or association calculation.
rules: paper_id and light_paper_id are the validated source.json identity; neither is a Vault source_id.
title/version come from explicit metadata; absent version is the closed unknown object, never an invented label.
markdown hash/size are computed from retained bytes; source_metadata_sha256 hashes exact source.json bytes, including spelling.
Pages are checked or re-derived from page-1..page-N anchors and headings. Citation offsets are Unicode character offsets; hashes use UTF-8 bytes.

original_pdf_sha256 is non-null only when a verified PDF digest from a capture/intake predecessor independently matches the retained metadata binding; a light source digest or directory name alone is not PDF evidence, otherwise null.

findings.finding: Only current, source-owned light chunks can become Markdown evidence locators.
rules: Require current index and one complete current paper snapshot; validate each cited row against source.md, page, markdown path/hash, text_start/text_end and text_sha256.
Reject foreign paper IDs, non-source locators, unknown chunks, stale index/record, changed source path/hash, duplicate identities, empty spans and normalization collisions.
Translate each accepted chunk to a Markdown locator with source_id derived from .raw/captured/<markdown_sha256>.md, association reference, page anchor, half-open Unicode charspan and excerpt hash.
Run markdown_locator.resolve_markdown_locator against retained raw bytes before staging.

findings.finding: Use source_versions.associate_source with actual raw bytes and retained predecessor history; preserve its proposed/reused association as a payload.
rules: source_id derives only from exact raw path/hash and content bytes.
Pass exact head, complete receipts, current and historical ledger bytes, all associations, raw sources, extraction artifacts and registration ledgers.
Identical version/bytes/proof/observation reuses byte-for-byte; different observation, proof, path/hash or owner is a typed conflict.
The extraction descriptor is canonical observation JSON at .raw/derived/markdown-source/<markdown_sha256>/<observation_sha256>.json; conversion never recreates the raw capture.

findings.finding: Map only non-unknown light sections into stable canonical v2 provisional claims.
rules: Use exact validated section text; do not normalize it to defeat identity collisions.
Unknown sections emit no claim or citation. Every emitted claim has accepted Markdown evidence and remains provisional.
Only summary is a core candidate; model output does not imply core or acceptance.
Free-text concepts remain unmapped suggestions unless explicit frozen taxonomy mapping is supplied.
Duplicate text with incompatible section ownership/evidence is a typed refusal, not a merge.

findings.finding: Genesis and invalidation are system events, not human assessment.
rules: New claims receive deterministic v2 system genesis events with reviewed_at null and provisional lifecycle.
Changed evidence appends a v2 system evidence-invalidation successor and returns the claim to provisional with reviewed_at null.
Unchanged text/evidence retains prior claim/event/assessment-head bytes exactly.
Incompatible text, owner, section or lifecycle changes refuse. No human review, source review promotion, display choice, retirement reactivation or default display selection is created.

findings.finding: Compile complete current audited state plus the association and mapped claims, then use existing source-v1 state/compiler validation before prepare.
rules: Preserve old papers, claims, associations, observations, snapshots, decisions, events, ledger rows and registry heads byte-for-byte unless an explicit derived successor is required.
Claims and paper references absent from this light record are retained, never deleted.

Include association, exact observation/extraction, source ledger successor where required, paper v2, claim ledger, provisional events, assessment-heads and complete generated pages; keep source-display decisions/heads unchanged.

Metadata must explicitly provide title/authors/published_at/aliases/taxonomy/code fields where required. Do not substitute conversion time, infer authors/taxonomy or use light paper ID as DOI/arXiv. v2 accepts a canonical date or UTC timestamp; source_state must validate that chosen grammar consistently.
Recompute complete compiler pages and derived registries; do not add another compiler or receipt constructor.

findings.finding: Preparation and inspection use one retained snapshot and one current basis.
rules: Open one retained audited Vault snapshot before current-state collection. Retain named directories and every input file required by source_state, compiler and source_versions through assembly, prepare and inspect.

Under one retention boundary retain papers/<digest>/source.md and source.json, .light-index/index.v1.json, .light-knowledge/HEADS.json, selected five-file record bundle, and referenced batch/refresh provenance and ancestor bundles.

Read only retained bytes after retention. On success and every exception path verify all retained directory edges and descriptors; replacement, missing, symlink, hardlink or special input yields typed refusal.

Call prepare_source_publication with sorted exact path-to-bytes payload. If registration already exists, do not use registration branch. Use its no_change envelope for empty effect; never construct a minItems=0 request.

Call inspect_source_publication on the staged request while retaining the same Vault/upstream snapshot. Basis, inventory, read preconditions, transport and upstream authority must derive from that snapshot. Applying receipt remains an operator action.

conditional_edges: ancestor record bundles named by ancestry
refresh or selection provenance for extended wrappers

record_selection: Require pointer_head_record_id and current_head_record_id to agree.
Require _record_bundle_ok with ancestry, completed-job and job-result binding enabled for extended records.
Reject old heads, pointer/current mismatch, edited managed bytes, unexpected files, symlinks, hardlinks, traversal or incomplete ancestry.
Capture index_id and paper_snapshot and bind them to every mapped citation and output envelope.

required: current source ledger and all historical source-ledger snapshots
all existing associations, observations, extractions, decisions, papers, claim ledger, events, registry heads and generated pages required by source_state
identity_rules: Earliest registration receipt and ledger snapshot establish predecessor; a later ledger with matching content but missing history is not equivalent.
Current ledger may supply historical snapshot only when its exact hash is the required predecessor hash.
Retain every byte before parsing and verify again after assembly and inspect.

inputs: validated capture authority path and receipt-backed registration predecessor
batch_id and operation_id distinct from every predecessor
outputs: no_change envelope when prospective bytes equal current audited state
otherwise staged source-publication request path and canonical request hash
after inspect, source-publication authority with request, transaction declaration/staging, complete read preconditions, receipt/head proposal and upstream authority
typed refusal with no durable authority on any retained-input, predecessor, basis, citation, history or metadata failure
forbidden_outputs: applied receipt or mutable Vault write
success after retained input changed or disappeared

required_acceptance_vectors: Synthetic isolated chain: completed light record -> capture authority -> receipt-backed Markdown registration -> conversion -> source-publication prepare -> inspect -> explicitly approved isolated fixture apply -> typed source-state audit. Never report fixtures as real authorization.
Run identical conversion twice; second run is byte-stable no_change with no new receipt/event.
Change light HEAD, source.md/source.json, page anchors, index bytes or cited Unicode text between reads; refuse stale/source/index and emit no authority.
Foreign citation, non-source locator, unknown chunk, changed path/hash, empty span, CRLF/Unicode offset mismatch and normalization collision all refuse without rewriting text.
Legacy and v2 histories: unchanged accepted evidence stays byte-identical; changed evidence appends only typed system invalidation and clears reviewed_at; incompatible text/owner/section refuses.
Duplicate incompatible section ownership, missing citation, all-unknown document and free-text concepts have explicit closed outcomes.
Capture reuse, association reuse, source-version conflict and missing/late/orphan registration receipt produce exact reuse or typed refusal; historical bytes are never overwritten.
Replacement/delete/symlink/hardlink/race on named light or Vault input during success and exception paths produces typed unsafe/stale and never a prepared request.
Payload/path/digest limits, stale operation head, changed read precondition, incomplete source inventory and installed-wheel schema/resource checks.

unresolved_freeze_questions.question: What closed metadata input is authoritative for title, authors, publication date, aliases, DOI/arXiv, code URLs and taxonomy, and how is its exact file/hash retained?
unresolved_freeze_questions.required_decision: Freeze metadata schema/path; require explicit real published_at date or UTC timestamp. Missing/guessed fields refuse.

unresolved_freeze_questions.question: Which batch/refresh provenance files and ancestor bundles are required for each extended record mode, and what bound applies to the retained tree?
unresolved_freeze_questions.required_decision: Freeze recursive allowlist and byte/file limits; redirect validators to retained descriptors only.

unresolved_freeze_questions.question: How does one same-snapshot identity flow from light validation through Vault assembly, prepare and inspect without reopening live paths?
unresolved_freeze_questions.required_decision: Freeze a retained-session descriptor with named edge identities, exact bytes or safe handles, input hashes, index_id, record_id, operation-head hash, receipt head and ledger predecessor; verify final edges on every exit.

unresolved_freeze_questions.question: What exact canonical compiler entrypoint/input envelope accepts complete historical state plus new provisional rows without changing legacy pages?
unresolved_freeze_questions.required_decision: Freeze entrypoint, registry mirrors and byte-stability rules before implementation; do not use publication_bridge's legacy generic-stage path.

unresolved_freeze_questions.question: Does conversion accept only an already receipt-backed registration, or prepare a registration predecessor too?
unresolved_freeze_questions.required_decision: This bounded package requires an already receipt-backed registration. Same-call registration would need a separate contract/freeze.

read/write a real Vault or run vpwiki-admin
treat light digest, model proposal, test approval fixture or prospective source ID as authority
change frozen 67-entry catalog/overlays or source-publication contracts
